name: secure-coding
description: Write and review application code in Java, Kotlin, C#, Python and TypeScript with rules for the risks in the OWASP Top 10, the OWASP API Security Top 10 and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications: access checks per object and tenant, safe queries and paths, no type names from input, no secrets or fødselsnummer in logs, Maskinporten and ID-porten tokens, and language-model features. Keeps answers in proportion: no new dependencies or invented helpers, minimal fixes, tests that fail without the control, and no findings for safe code.
